**Seat errors recorded:**
- **Model tier, the whole shift (maintainer-caught, 2026-09-27T13:0xZ).** The pm-dispatch skill makes the default judgment tier (`opus`) the execution default. The ceiling (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) is 「按卡取用非新默认」, per card and mandatory only on protocol-semantics surfaces. After an early `opus` quota wall, this seat wrote `model: fable (the ceiling)` into every order and never re-checked, so every dev and reviewer ran at the ceiling. None of these UI cards touched a protocol-semantics surface. When the fable weekly quota reached 94%, the seat stopped all six running ceiling-tier agents. It re-dispatched the four devs at `opus` from their on-disk state, and relaunched reviews at `opus`. Lesson: a quota wall moves DOWN a tier or lowers concurrency, never up. A temporary deviation carries an end condition that is re-read at every check-in.
- **Review briefs (same finding).** The seat's review prompts told reviewers to open worktrees and re-run pins, ablations and type-checks. `contract-review.md` says 「只读 diff 与卡片,check 结论取 head 的 check-runs,⛔ 永不本地重跑派生门禁族」. Briefs now use the read-only shape: one named probe at most, and only with a stated reason.
- objectui#7699 (12:28Z): the seat wrote `pm:dispatched` and the assignee BEFORE the claim's dry-run. The claim was then refused (a two-id `Thread-read:`), which left a half-state of about one minute until claim `5855823570` posted. This repeats objectui#10659's lesson (dry-run the claim first, write no label unless it posted). The claim job's order is back to claim-first.
- objectui#10714's base-merge order attributed main's `data-display.ts` move to PR objectui#10761; the dev measured it as PR objectui#10710 and wrote the merge message accordingly.
- The 06:15Z ledger refresh was stamped 06:30Z.

- This shift's claims recorded `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test CARD_NUMBER`: NOT GOVERNED. The tool reads its arguments as file PATHS, so every one of those readings checked a path named after the card, and was vacuous. Re-run at 19:40Z over the real surfaces of every in-flight card (13 paths), it read NOT GOVERNED, so no conclusion changes. objectui#7599's claim is the first to use the real path (⛔ GOVERNED, `skills/**`).

Against the released base it was evaluated by `@object-ui/core`'s non-CEL evaluator, so the changeset contradicted itself. The round-3 review caught it, and round 4 drops the qualifier.
- objectui#10667: the round-2 replacement header clause this seat supplied said the base filter is "inherited unless the page defines `filterBy`". It is always inherited, with `filterBy` appended. The round-2 review caught it, and round 3 corrected it before landing.
- objectui#10659: the claim job posted no `Claim:` (refused: its `Thread-read` was not an id) yet went on to write `pm:dispatched` and the assignee, a half-state of about one minute. The claim was re-posted and the order patched before dispatch. The claim job now dry-runs the claim first and writes no label unless the claim posted.
- 16:10Z to 18:25Z: an API session limit stopped every dev and reviewer. The merge queue kept landing, and hourly patrols fired unanswered. The seat resumed every agent from its on-disk state.

- objectui#10537's order named `@object-ui/core`'s non-CEL `ExpressionEvaluator` as "the same engine"; the dev measured it and used `@objectstack/formula`.
- objectui#8932's claim cited the in-repo `exports` map; the published 17.6.0 has `.` only.

- objectui#10685's ruling (A) and objectui#9590's (A+) were relayed to their devs in-session and reached GitHub only in the `Release:` notes at sign-off. Lesson: post a seat ruling on the card in the same round it is relayed.

## 4. Notes (durable)

- `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr N` and `dispatch-gates.mjs` answer only for objectstack. For objectui, derive the path surface from the PR's file list.
- Four `domain:ui` seats are live at once (seat 1 objectui#5560, seat 3 objectui#9800, seat 4 objectui#10243, this one). Re-read open-PR file lists and live claims before every claim; the board moves in minutes.
- `git fetch A B` sets `FETCH_HEAD` to the **first** ref: fetch into a named ref for any `merge-tree` probe.
- A two-dot diff against a moved `main` shows main's newer commits as this PR's deletions. Judge a PR by three-dot or by its file list.
- `objectstack-ai/cloud` is unreachable from this session (REST 403, `add_repo` refused). Cloud-contract cards (objectui#8524, #10109's envelope, #10432's sentence, #10439's verdict) carry that as a declared reading gap.
- objectui squash-merges with PR title + PR body, so a commit-level trailer does not reach `main`.
- The shared objectstack checkout is older than `origin/main` (`a4ca69a`). Dispatch orders point devs at the role file on `origin/main` and carry its PR-assignee increment.
- Every write at sign-off went through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` or the fleet relay; the budget is 40 writes an hour, shared with every seat.
